aiScoreCriteriaQualification: UNGM registration level, dedicated compliance role and remediation, English bid documents available now vs the notice's eligibility and compliance requirements
aiScoreCriteriaExperience: Tender progress and awards in the last 24 months, value band of the latest bid, technical response and delivered cases vs the notice's track-record threshold
aiScoreCriteriaCertification: Mandatory documents available now (English business licence, ISO certificates, third-party test reports, certificates of origin, etc.) vs the notice's checklist
aiScoreCriteriaRegion: Ability to deliver to the project country, after-sales points and overseas branches vs the notice's delivery and localisation requirements
aiScoreCriteriaScale: Export/international volume, bid team and record-keeping, familiar procurement frameworks vs the project's budget and scope
aiScoreCriteriaDelivery: Pre-submission review process and English Q&A capability vs the notice's schedule, clarification meetings and milestones
aiScoreCriteriaPrice: Cost computation, FOB/CIF/DDP pricing capability and acceptance of payment terms beyond 30 days vs the notice's budget and payment terms
